header.title: SSSS November Newsletter
header.description: Halloween has passed and Christmas is right around the corner, let's see what the SSSS was up to during the month of November!

text: a PEAK event (get it?), the SSSS climbed the rocks and made some friends along the way!

text: The SSSS hosted a great HTML + CSS Workshop, teaching the next generation of developers!
If you missed out but want to learn some web dev, click the link to the github repo below!
